author: human
request:
Bug report: opening /owners?page=0 — or any page value below 1 — renders the
error page instead of the owner list. Expected behavior: the owner listing
treats any page value below 1 as the first page and responds with the normal
listing (HTTP 200). Find the cause, fix it, and cover the fix with a test.

author: product-requirements-expert
title: Owner listing opens the first page when a page before the first is requested
summary: A request for the owner listing at a page before the first shows the first page of owners instead of the error page. Valid pages are unaffected.
acceptance_criteria: given a request for the owner listing at a page before the first, when it runs, then the first page of owners is listed rather than an error page
given the same request with the listing filtered by last name, when it runs, then the first page of matches is listed rather than an error page
given a request for a page that exists, when it runs, then that page of owners is listed
non_goals: the veterinarian directory's handling of a page before the first — recorded as an open question
a page beyond the last page, or a page that is not a whole number — recorded as an open question
notes: Bug fix. PRD edge case 4 of Owner records requires the unfiltered and last-name-filtered listings to follow the same rule; the first two acceptance criteria are the natural data-driven cases of one behavior, so the first test name may carry both. Owner decision quoted in the intake-decision at line 1 covers the owner listing only.

author: system-design-expert
architectural_fit: No new design ground. The owner listing already owns the 1-based page number to 0-based page index translation in OwnerController's private paging helper (system-design.md#contracts OwnerController row; the Constants section records page size as a local of that helper). The defect is that the translation passes a negative index to PageRequest.of, which throws and lands on the error page. Correcting a page before the first to the first page happens inside that same translation, so the fix stays a request-binding concern in the layer that already performs it. No new type, package, or repository method. The only docs change is the OwnerController Contracts row, which now names REQ-OWN-005 and states the correction.
integration_points: Repository boundary (OwnerRepository.findByLastNameStartingWith): reuse the @MockitoBean OwnerRepository already declared in OwnerControllerTests and stubbed in its @BeforeEach. Mockito is the tolerated existing double here (CLAUDE.md testing strategy); do not introduce a second double for this boundary.
Framework transport (HTTP): MockMvc under the file's existing @WebMvcTest(OwnerController.class) slice — the one sanctioned mock, driving real binding and dispatch.

Model contract to owners/ownersList: currentPage, totalPages, totalItems, listOwners are set in addPaginationModel; currentPage must carry the corrected page so the rendered pager links are consistent.

patterns.description: findPaginatedForOwnersLastName — the existing page-number to page-index translation the correction belongs in

@BeforeEach stub shape: given(owners.findByLastNameStartingWith(eq(name), any(Pageable.class))).willReturn(new PageImpl<>(...)) — an unfiltered-listing case needs an eq("") stub, and a last-name-filtered case an eq(<name>) stub

risks.risk: Correcting the page only inside the paging helper leaves addPaginationModel receiving the raw requested value, so the view renders a pager anchored on a page that does not exist.
risks.mitigation: Normalize the requested page once in processFindForm, before both the repository call and addPaginationModel, so one corrected value feeds both (security-principles.md § Trust Boundaries: validate type, range, and shape before use, at the boundary rather than scattered past it).

risks.risk: The correction is written as a domain rule in the controller, extending the deviation architecture-principles.md already records.
risks.mitigation: Keep it as request-parameter normalization on the transport surface, not a rule about owners: no new branch expressing a business decision (architecture-principles.md § pattern catalog Web controller row and its checklist line — a new rule in a controller is a fresh violation).

risks.risk: A stub returning a single owner makes the listing assertion pass for the wrong reason: one total element redirects to that owner's detail page instead of rendering the list.
risks.mitigation: Stub a page carrying more than one owner for both listing tests, and assert the owners/ownersList view plus HTTP 200 (testing-principles.md assertion guidance).

risks.risk: The same helper shape exists in VetController, inviting a shared extraction that leaves this slice's scope.
risks.mitigation: Leave the vet listing untouched — the prd-entry records it as an open question and a non-goal; no shared paging abstraction in this slice.

notes: Five-signal foundational check: none tripped. system-design.md, the ADR set (framework, architecture shape, persistence), and ubiquitous-language.md are all populated and partly human-confirmed; paging is a presentation concern with no domain term, so no vocabulary addition. No design-doc-autofix records exist in the log, so the autofix audit is empty. Cover claim resolved by reading OwnerController.java directly (lines 94-137) rather than by symbol oracle — the IntelliJ MCP tools are not in this dispatch's tool list, so this is the weaker basis. Out of scope by the prd-entry's non_goals and unchanged by this slice: a page beyond the last (Spring Data returns an empty page, the controller reports no owner found) and a non-numeric page value (binding type mismatch reaches the error page). Both remain open questions, not defects this slice settles. No ADR: the correction re-opens no recorded decision and constrains no future slice.
